'''Mazzlo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] broker who worked in the [[Nova Orion Station]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Mazzlo appeared as a non-player character in the video game Star Wars Galaxies, a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by LucasArts, prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
